name: Kin'youbi no Umi to Taiyou
source:
Main character gets woken up by the voice of his lover Katsuragi who is also his senior at the company. On Friday they take a break from work and come to Katsuragi parents' house.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角被恋人葛城的声音叫醒。葛城也是他的公司前辈。星期五，两人暂时离开工作岗位，一起去了葛城父母的家。

[来自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
